In the [[Standard year|years]] prior to the [[Battle of Yavin]], this '''Stormtrooper Commander''' was stationed at an [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] facility of landed [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter|TIE fighters]] on the [[planet]] [[Lothal]]. During one of his patrols, he encountered the [[Mandalorian]] explosive [[artist]] and rebel from the ''[[Ghost]]'' crew [[Sabine Wren]].

==Biography==
The [[Stormtrooper Commander]] was stationed outside an [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] outpost of landed [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter|TIE fighters]] on the [[planet]] [[Lothal]] a few [[Standard year|years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin]]. A Lothal citizen was in the area, and the [[Commanding officer|commander]] assaulted him before ordering him to leave the restricted area. Shortly thereafter, a rebel named [[Sabine Wren]] snuck into the facility and drew the attention of two [[stormtrooper]]s, including [[TK-626]], who called for reinforcements. The commander and several other [[trooper]]s arrived and searched for Wren in the facility, before finding an explosive that she had attached to the wing of a TIE [[Starfighter|fighter]], in the center of [[graffiti]] [[Artist|art]] she had painted onto the side of the [[Starship|ship]]. Wren set off the explosive, destroying the TIE fighter and covering all of the troopers with paint. The explosion caused the distracted stormtroopers to miss the rebel starship ''[[Ghost]]'', on which Wren was a [[Spectres|crew member]]; the ''Ghost'' used the explosion as a diversion to fly away without being seen.<ref name="Art Attack" />

==Equipment==
The Stormtrooper Commander donned an [[Color|orange]] pauldron and wielded an [[E-11 medium blaster rifle]].<ref name="Art Attack" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Stormtrooper Commander was voiced by [[Greg Weisman]], one of the executive producers of ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]''.<ref name="Greg Weisman tweet">{{Twitter|Greg_Weisman|status/501607888314331136|[[Greg Weisman]]|date=2014-08-19|quote='@RebelsReport: The shoulder pauldron strikes back. #StarWarsRebels' That's me!|archivedate=20190904233815}}</ref>
